title: Integral and evaluated reduction Tor intervals
statement: Fix ell,E,T,D and a coefficient-ring isomorphism e as in [def-sp-reduction-tower-data]. Let red be any derived functor with evaluation isomorphisms to D.scalar extension along e and the quotient projections. Assume T qcqs. For a source complex M whose internalization is bounded constructible, that internalization has finite Tor amplitude. For every ordered Tor interval [a,b] of it, every evaluated reduction has HasProEtaleTorAmplitude in [a,b] and its homology vanishes outside [a,b]. No normalization condition or finite-level constructibility conclusion is included.

source.place: Construction, normalization, and constructibility assertions; final Tor-amplitude sentence

proof.text: The section/internal equivalence identifies integral coefficients and their derived tensor. Apply the integral qcqs Tor theorem, transporting the finite extension E to an isomorphic finite intermediate field if needed; scalar and module equivalences preserve finite constant models. A cohomological interval [r,s] gives [r-1,s], hence finite Tor amplitude.

proof.text: For every quotient-module N in degree zero use Res((M tensor R_n) tensor N) = M tensor Res N. Exact scalar restriction preserves underlying homology. Thus any Tor interval of M bounds every such tensor, with no flatness of the quotient map.

lean.statement:
theorem sp_reduction_tower_tor_intervals
    (D : SpCoefficientTowersAbelian l E T)
    (coefficient : spIntegralSectionRing l E T ≅
      WeilConjectures.completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)
    (red : DerivedCategory (spIntegralSectionModules l E T) ⥤
      spDerivedCoefficientTowers l E T D)
    (evaluation : spReductionDerivedEvaluations l E T D coefficient red)
    [CompactSpace T] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T]
    (M : DerivedCategory (spIntegralSectionModules l E T))
    (hM : constantModelBoundedConstructible (spIntegralCondensed l E) T
      ((spIntegralInternalization l E T).obj M)) :
    DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ ((spIntegralInternalization l E T).obj M) ∧
    ∀ (a b : ℤ), a ≤ b →
      DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn _ a b ((spIntegralInternalization l E T).obj M) →
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        Scheme.HasProEtaleTorAmplitude T
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E ⧸ spEllIdeal l E ^ (n + 1))
          ((spDerivedCoefficientEvaluation l E T D n).obj (red.obj M)) a b ∧
        ∀ i : ℤ, (i < a ∨ b < i) → IsZero
          ((@DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (Scheme.proEtaleRingModules T (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRing T
              (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E ⧸ spEllIdeal l E ^ (n + 1))))
            _ _ (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) i).obj
            ((spDerivedCoefficientEvaluation l E T D n).obj (red.obj M)))
